# Best AI Datasets

> bestaidatasets.com ranks the 14 best places to find AI and machine learning datasets as of 9 November 2026. Every pick was checked against its own official pages. The order is Hugging Face Hub, Kaggle, Common Crawl, FineWeb, Dolma, LAION, Google Dataset Search, the AWS Registry of Open Data, UCI, OpenML, BigQuery public datasets, Azure Open Datasets, Data.gov and Zenodo. The site has four pages: the ranked list (with a comparison table, how-to-choose section and FAQ), methodology, about, and an access-costs page. Each page has matching JSON-LD. OpenML's homepage blocked our reader, so its entry relies on its official documentation. Kaggle's dataset count is its own February 2025 figure, not a live count. FineWeb's row count was not checked directly, so it is left out.

- [Best AI Datasets (2026): 14 Top Sources Ranked](https://bestaidatasets.com/): The best AI and machine learning datasets and dataset hubs in 2026, ranked: Hugging Face, Kaggle, Common Crawl, FineWeb, Dolma, LAION and more, with licenses and costs.
- [AI Dataset Access Costs Compared (2026)](https://bestaidatasets.com/dataset-access-costs.html): What it actually costs to access and store AI datasets on Hugging Face, Kaggle, BigQuery, AWS, Azure and Common Crawl, using official 2026 pricing and limits.
- [How We Ranked the Best AI Datasets | Methodology](https://bestaidatasets.com/methodology.html): How bestaidatasets.com researched and ranked AI dataset sources: official sources only, task coverage, documentation, licensing clarity, access cost and freshness.
- [About Best AI Datasets](https://bestaidatasets.com/about.html): bestaidatasets.com is an independent research site that compares AI and machine learning dataset sources using only their official, publicly available information.
